newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close higher in continuing rally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close higher in continuing rally.

text.p: Dhaka stocks climbed 2.68 percent on a record volume as both small and institutional investors traded strongly in a share-hungry market, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index closed 90.22 points or 2.68 percent higher at 3,448.88. The turnover was 1.065 billion taka. Of 126 traded issues, 89 gained and 37 lost.

Brokers said the investors were taking positions ahead of annual meetings of a large number of companies in November and December. The market will remain bullish in the next couple of sessions before falling on profit-taking. Bangladesh Tobacco rose 20.08 taka to 421.6 and Shine Pukur lost 13.28 to 537.34.
